title: Take away their most efficient high-volume actions
supporting_stats: Offensive Rebound: 77.8% on 18 attempts; Cut: 62.3% on 106 attempts
recommendation: Each is 5+ points above their 48.5% overall clip on 15+ attempts. Offensive Rebound: hit a body on every shot before going to the ball. Cut: jump to the ball on every pass and see man and ball -- no back-cuts behind ball-watchers.

title: Funnel them into their worst high-volume looks
supporting_stats: Spot-Up: 33.2% on 223 attempts; Off Screen: 36.7% on 30 attempts
recommendation: Each is 5+ points below their 48.5% overall clip -- don't help off these actions; make them keep taking them.

title: Pressure the actions they turn it over on
supporting_stats: Hand Off: 5 TO in 28 uses (17.9% vs 8.6% across all actions); Post-Up: 19 TO in 118 uses (16.1% vs 8.6% across all actions)
recommendation: Loosest actions per use, not the most common ones -- load ball pressure and gap help onto these specifically rather than pressing everything.
